title: Cursed Altar
description: A black stone altar squats in a chamber lit by guttering green flames that burn without fuel. Old blood stains its surface in concentric rings, and dark energy pulses from deep within the stone in a slow, rhythmic throb like a second heartbeat. Small offerings — coins, trinkets, a severed hand — are arrayed around its base.

choices.label: Take the cursed relic
choices.description: A blackened artifact rests at the altar's center, thrumming with power.

outcomes.text: You snatch the relic and run. The green flames roar behind you but do not follow. The artifact hums darkly in your pack.
The relic comes free easily — too easily. A wave of necrotic energy washes over your party as the altar's curse lashes out.
The moment you touch the relic, the altar erupts. Bone shards and green flame blast outward. Undead guardians claw their way from the floor.

choices.label: Search the offerings
choices.description: The faithful left coin and trinket alike at the altar's feet.

outcomes.text: You scoop up coins and a few small gems from among the grisly offerings. The altar ignores your petty theft.
A generous haul of coin, plus a pouch of grave dust someone left as an offering. Their loss, your gain.
As you reach for the coins, the severed hand twitches and clamps around your wrist. You wrench free, but the grip leaves burns.

choices.label: Back away slowly
choices.description: Cursed altars are best left to their dark purpose.

outcomes.text: You retreat from the chamber. The green flames dim as you cross the threshold, as if disappointed.
